## The model

<details markdown="1">
<summary>The same model, as math</summary>

The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods` keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.

| $`\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_curve` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost` curve: one of PyPSA's `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`) |
| $`\mathrm{Link\_maint\_ext}`$ | `Link_maint_ext` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a maintainable link with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period, unless it is committable and modular. These are the maintenance rows against the chosen build |
| $`\mathrm{Process\_maint\_ext}`$ | `Process_maint_ext` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \mathcal{T}`$ — a maintainable process with an extendable build that is active in the snapshot's period, unless it is committable and modular. These are the maintenance rows against the chosen build |

#### Variables

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mu`$ | `Generator_maintenance` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Generator-maintenance` — whether a maintainable generator is in maintenance: continuous, and one exactly where an event covers the snapshot |
| $`\mu^{\mathrm{nom}}`$ | `Generator_maintenance_capacity` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Generator-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise: the product the `maintcap` rows linearise |
| $`\mu^{\mathrm{up}}`$ | `Generator_maintenance_start` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Generator-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot |
| $`C^{\mathrm{curve}}`$ | `Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along a curve, held above the curve |
| $`p`$ | `Generator_p` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot |
| $`P`$ | `Generator_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{G}`$ — `Generator-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a generator that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`\mu^{f}`$ | `Link_maintenance` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Link-maintenance` — whether a maintainable link is in maintenance: continuous, and one exactly where an event covers the snapshot |
| $`\mu^{f,\mathrm{nom}}`$ | `Link_maintenance_capacity` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Link-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise: the product the `maintcap` rows linearise |
| $`\mu^{f,\mathrm{up}}`$ | `Link_maintenance_start` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Link-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot |
| $`f`$ | `Link_p` over $`\mathcal{L} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Link-p` — PyPSA's `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value withdraws there and injects at every bus the link's output ports deliver to |
| $`F`$ | `Link_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{L}`$ — `Link-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a link that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |
| $`\mu^{z}`$ | `Process_maintenance` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Process-maintenance` — whether a maintainable process is in maintenance: continuous, and one exactly where an event covers the snapshot |
| $`\mu^{z,\mathrm{nom}}`$ | `Process_maintenance_capacity` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Process-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise: the product the `maintcap` rows linearise |
| $`\mu^{z,\mathrm{up}}`$ | `Process_maintenance_start` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$, $`0`$ where the mask leaves it out — `Process-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot |
| $`z`$ | `Process_p` over $`\mathcal{J} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — `Process-p` — PyPSA's internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive |
| $`Z`$ | `Process_p_nom_ext` over $`\mathcal{J}`$ — `Process-p_nom` — nominal internal power where it is a decision, for a process that is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name |

#### Definitions

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`\mathit{Bus\_injection}`$ | `Bus_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_capex}`$ | `Generator_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_injection}`$ | `Generator_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_opex}`$ | `Generator_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}`$ | `Generator_running_cost` over $`\mathcal{G} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a generator's output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_capex}`$ | `Link_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Link\_injection}`$ | `Link_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_opex}`$ | `Link_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Link_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{O} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_demand}`$ | `Load_demand` over $`\mathcal{D} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`) |
| $`\mathrm{Load\_injection}`$ | `Load_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_capex}`$ | `Process_capex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{Process\_injection}`$ | `Process_injection` over $`\mathcal{N} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_opex}`$ | `Process_opex` over $`\Xi`$ |
| $`\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}`$ | `Process_output_arrival` over $`\mathcal{R} \times \Xi \times \mathcal{T}`$ — what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not |
| $`\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}`$ | `risk_weighted_opex` (scalar) |
| $`\mathit{scenario\_opex}`$ | `scenario_opex` over $`\Xi`$ — what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot's hours and its period, before the scenario's own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted, as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`) |
| $`\mathit{total\_cost}`$ | `total_cost` (scalar) — what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail |

#### Notation

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $`t \ominus k`$ | `edge='wrap'` — $`t-k`$, cyclic |
| $`t \boxminus_{v} k`$ | `edge=v` — $`t-k`$, and $`v`$ past the edge |
| $`t \ominus^{\mathrm{relation}(t)} k`$ | `within=relation[...]` — $`t-k`$ inside the group of $`t`$ |

#### Conditions

**`Generator_maint_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_maint\_ext}_{g,t} \iff \mathrm{mnt}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{g} > 0 \right) \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_marginal_cost_curve`**

```math
\mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \iff \lvert \{ b \in \mathcal{B} \,:\, \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{curve}}_{b,g} \text{ is defined} \} \rvert > 0 \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G}
```

**`Link_maint_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{Link\_maint\_ext}_{l,t} \iff \mathrm{mnt}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{com}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{f}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{l} > 0 \right) \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_maint_ext`**

```math
\mathrm{Process\_maint\_ext}_{j,t} \iff \mathrm{mnt}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \neg \left( \mathrm{com}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{z}^{\mathrm{mod}}_{j} > 0 \right) \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

#### Variable domains

**`Generator_maintenance`**

```math
0 \le \mu_{g,\xi,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_maintenance_capacity`**

```math
\mu^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi,t} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_maint\_ext}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_maintenance_start`**

```math
\mu^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \{0, 1\} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise`**

```math
C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_p_nom_ext`**

```math
P_{g} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g}
```

**`Link_maintenance`**

```math
0 \le \mu^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_maintenance_capacity`**

```math
\mu^{f,\mathrm{nom}}_{l,\xi,t} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_maint\_ext}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_maintenance_start`**

```math
\mu^{f,\mathrm{up}}_{l,\xi,t} \in \{0, 1\} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_p`**

```math
f_{l,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{f}_{l,t}
```

**`Link_p_nom_ext`**

```math
F_{l} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{f}_{l} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Process_maintenance`**

```math
0 \le \mu^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \le 1 \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_maintenance_capacity`**

```math
\mu^{z,\mathrm{nom}}_{j,\xi,t} \ge 0 \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_maint\_ext}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_maintenance_start`**

```math
\mu^{z,\mathrm{up}}_{j,\xi,t} \in \{0, 1\} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

**`Process_p`**

```math
z_{j,\xi,t} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{on}^{z}_{j,t}
```

```math
Z_{j} \in \mathbb{R} \qquad \forall\, j \in \mathcal{J} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}^{z}_{j} \wedge \mathrm{act}^{z}_{j}
```

#### Definitions

**`Bus_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} + \mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_capex} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot P_{g} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap}}_{g,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}_{g}
```

**`Generator_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_bus}(g) = n} \mathrm{sgn}_{g} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Generator_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} \mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{g \in \mathcal{G}} p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{(2)}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Generator_running_cost`**

```math
\mathit{Generator\_running\_cost}_{g,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} C^{\mathrm{curve}}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{Generator\_marginal\_cost\_curve}_{g} \\ p_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}_{g,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_capex} = \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot F_{l} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},f}_{l,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{f}_{l}
```

**`Link_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = -\left( \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_bus0}(l) = n} f_{l,\xi,t} \right) + \sum_{o \in \mathcal{O} \,:\, \mathrm{Link\_output\_bus}(o) = n} \mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Link_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{l \in \mathcal{L}} f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot f_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{f,(2)}_{l,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Link_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Link\_output\_arrival}_{o,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{f}_{o} \\ f_{\mathrm{Link\_output\_link}(o),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{f}} \cdot \eta_{o,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, o \in \mathcal{O},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_demand`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} \mathrm{sgn}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \cdot \mathrm{load}_{d,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{on}^{\mathrm{load}}_{d} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, d \in \mathcal{D},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Load_injection`**

```math
\mathrm{Load\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{d \in \mathcal{D} \,:\, \mathrm{Load\_bus}(d) = n} \mathrm{Load\_demand}_{d,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_capex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_capex} = \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J},\ \xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot Z_{j} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{\mathrm{cap},z}_{j,\xi} \cdot \mathrm{W}^{z}_{j}
```

**`Process_injection`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R} \,:\, \mathrm{Process\_output\_bus}(r) = n} \mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`Process_opex`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} = \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \sum_{j \in \mathcal{J}} z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot z_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{c}^{z,(2)}_{j,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{w}_{t} \cdot \mathrm{w}^{y}_{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`Process_output_arrival`**

```math
\mathit{Process\_output\_arrival}_{r,\xi,t} = \begin{cases} z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \ominus^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{if } \mathrm{cyc}^{z}_{r} \\ z_{\mathrm{Process\_output\_process}(r),\xi,t \boxminus_{0}^{\mathrm{snapshot\_period}(t)} \mathrm{d}^{z}} \cdot \alpha_{r,\xi,t} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \qquad \forall\, r \in \mathcal{R},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T}
```

**`risk_weighted_opex`**

```math
\mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex} = \sum_{\xi \in \Xi} \pi_{\xi} \cdot \mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi}
```

**`scenario_opex`**

```math
\mathit{scenario\_opex}_{\xi} = \mathit{Generator\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Link\_opex}_{\xi} + \mathit{Process\_opex}_{\xi} \qquad \forall\, \xi \in \Xi
```

**`total_cost`**

```math
\mathit{total\_cost} = \mathit{Generator\_capex} + \mathit{Link\_capex} + \mathit{Process\_capex} + \mathit{risk\_weighted\_opex}
```

#### Objective

```math
\min \mathit{total\_cost}
```

#### Subject to

**`Bus_nodal_balance`**

```math
\mathit{Bus\_injection}_{n,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, n \in \mathcal{N},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Bus\_attached}_{n,t}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \left( P_{g} - \gamma_{g,\xi} \cdot \mu^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi,t} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_nom_lower`**

```math
P_{g} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_nom_upper`**

```math
P_{g} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{act}_{g} \wedge \overline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \text{ is defined}
```

**`Generator_ext_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \left( P_{g} - \gamma_{g,\xi} \cdot \mu^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi,t} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_lower`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \ge \underline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \cdot \left( 1 - \gamma_{g,\xi} \cdot \mu_{g,\xi,t} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_fix_p_upper`**

```math
p_{g,\xi,t} \le \overline{\mathrm{p}}_{g,\xi,t} \cdot \mathrm{p}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \cdot \left( 1 - \gamma_{g,\xi} \cdot \mu_{g,\xi,t} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \neg \mathrm{ext}_{g} \wedge \neg \mathrm{com}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_maint_event_count`**

```math
\sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \mu^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi,t} = \mathrm{n}^{\mathrm{mnt}}_{g,\xi} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}_{g}
```

**`Generator_maint_start_horizon`**

```math
\mu^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi,t} = 0 \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t} \wedge \mathrm{blk}_{g,\xi,t}
```

**`Generator_maint_window`**

```math
\mu_{g,\xi,t} = \sum_{t' \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \left( t,\ g,\ \xi,\ t' \right) \in \mathrm{Generator\_maintenance\_cover}} \mu^{\mathrm{up}}_{g,\xi,t'} \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{mnt}_{g} \wedge \mathrm{on}_{g,t}
```

**`Generator_maintcap_lower_nommax`**

```math
\mu^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi,t} \ge P_{g} - \overline{\mathrm{p}}^{\mathrm{nom}}_{g,\xi} \cdot \left( 1 - \mu_{g,\xi,t} \right) \qquad \forall\, g \in \mathcal{G},\ \xi \in \Xi,\ t \in \mathcal{T} \,:\, \mathrm{Generator\_maint\_ext}_{g,t}
```

    ```yaml
    version: 0
    description: The file states a plain `n.optimize()`, its multi-period class under the `multi_investment_periods`
      keyword, and its stochastic class, which `n.set_scenarios(...)` sets. Every quantity chosen once the
      future is known (second-stage) spans the futures dispatch is chosen in (`scenario`). Capacity is chosen
      once, before the future is known, and paid at its expected cost in each investment `period` its build
      year and lifetime span. Operation is the expectation over the scenarios' weights, with a share priced
      at the worst-outcome mean cost (CVaR) only where a risk preference is set. A plain run's data has one
      scenario, one period, unit weights, no outage and every `active` flag true, so the problem is the standard
      one. On a security-constrained run, PyPSA copies each branch flow limit once per `outage`, and the outage
      factors, `active` flags and scenario weights come from data prep.
    dimensions:
      breakpoint: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: 'the corners of a piecewise-linear curve, in order.
          A curve runs over the breakpoints its data has rows for, so curves may differ in length'}
      bus: {description: network nodes}
      generator: {description: 'generating units, each on one bus'}
      link: {description: 'controllable connections, each from one bus to the buses it delivers to'}
      link_output: {description: 'a link''s output ports, one label per port a link declares. The labels are
          PyPSA''s `bus1`, `bus2`, … columns read long, data prep. A link of any number of output ports is
          then one term in the balance'}
      load: {description: 'demands, each on one bus'}
      period: {dtype: int, ordered: true, description: investment periods. It is PyPSA's `investment_periods`}
      process: {description: 'generalised multi-port converters, each with an internal power that every port
          draws or delivers at its own rate'}
      process_output: {description: 'a process''s ports, one label per port a process declares. The labels
          are PyPSA''s `bus0`, `bus1`, …, each with a signed `rate`, data prep. A process of any number of
          ports is then one term in the balance'}
      scenario: {description: 'the futures dispatch is chosen in, each with a weight'}

      Process_committable:
        dims: [process]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether internal power is gated by an on/off status decision
      Process_maintainable:
        dims: [process]
        dtype: bool
        description: 'whether a process must be taken off for maintenance within the horizon: in any scenario,
          as PyPSA takes the union over them (`components.py:1000-1003`)'
      Process_maintenance_events:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        dtype: int
        description: how many maintenance events occur within the horizon
      Process_maintenance_pu:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: the share of the build a maintenance event takes off
      Process_maintenance_start_blocked:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        dtype: bool
        description: true where no maintenance event may start, data prep. The snapshots it would cover there
          run past the end of the horizon or into one the process is not active in. It is PyPSA's `active
          & ~valid`, from `maintenance_duration` and the generator weightings
      Process_marginal_cost:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of one unit of internal power
      Process_marginal_cost_quadratic:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: cost of the square of one unit of internal power
      Process_output_cyclic_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether a delayed port's transfer wraps from the end of its investment period (PyPSA's
          `cyclic_delay0`, `cyclic_delay1`, …). Where it does not, the energy still in transit at each period's
          first snapshots is lost. The flag is the same in every scenario, as the delay is
      Process_output_delay:
        dims: [process_output]
        dtype: int
        description: snapshots a port's transfer lags its process's internal power (PyPSA's `delay0`, `delay1`,
          … read long). In data prep you divide it by the `snapshot_weightings.generators` value and round
          it up. It is zero for a port that transfers at once. A port has the same delay in every scenario,
          as a link's port has
      Process_p_max_pu:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: most internal power, per unit of nominal power
      Process_p_min_pu:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'least internal power, per unit of nominal power: negative for a process that runs both
          ways'
      Process_p_nom:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: nominal internal power
      Process_p_nom_extendable:
        dims: [process]
        dtype: bool
        description: whether the nominal internal power is a decision
      Process_p_nom_max:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: most nominal power an extendable process may be built at
      Process_p_nom_min:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        description: least nominal power an extendable process may be built at
      Process_p_nom_mod:
        dims: [process]
        missing: absent
        description: the module size a build comes in whole numbers of. No value means the build is continuous
      Process_rate:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: the energy a port draws or delivers per unit of internal power (PyPSA's `rate0`, `rate1`,
          … read long). It is negative where the port withdraws and positive where it injects. A link is a
          process whose `bus0` rate is minus one and whose output rates are its efficiencies. The rate at
          the snapshot the transfer arrives applies, so a delayed port transfers at its arrival snapshot's
          rate (`constraints.py:1575`)
      period_weight_objective:
        dims: [period]
        description: PyPSA's `investment_period_weightings.objective` — what a period's cost weighs. PyPSA
          reads it only under `multi_investment_periods`. Otherwise you feed one in data prep, whatever the
          column contains (`optimize.py:231-233`, `:293-297`)
      scenario_weight:
        dims: [scenario]
        description: PyPSA's `scenario_weightings.weight` — the probability of a future
      snapshot_weightings_objective:
        dims: [snapshot]
        description: PyPSA's `snapshot_weightings.objective` — hours a snapshot weighs in the cost
    variables:
      Generator_maintenance:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_active
        bounds: {lower: 0.0, upper: 1.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Generator-maintenance` — whether a maintainable generator is in maintenance: continuous,
          and one exactly where an event covers the snapshot'
      Generator_maintenance_capacity:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maint_ext
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Generator-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise:
          the product the `maintcap` rows linearise'
      Generator_maintenance_start:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_active
        domain: binary
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Generator-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot'
      Generator_p:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-p` — output of a generator in a snapshot'
      Generator_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [generator]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset
        description: '`Generator-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a generator that is active.
          A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Link_maintenance:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maintainable AND Link_active
        bounds: {lower: 0.0, upper: 1.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Link-maintenance` — whether a maintainable link is in maintenance: continuous, and
          one exactly where an event covers the snapshot'
      Link_maintenance_capacity:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maint_ext
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Link-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise:
          the product the `maintcap` rows linearise'
      Link_maintenance_start:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maintainable AND Link_active
        domain: binary
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Link-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot'
      Link_p:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_active
        description: '`Link-p` — PyPSA''s `p0`, the flow measured at the `Link_bus0` end. A positive value
          withdraws there and injects at every bus the link''s output ports deliver to'
      Link_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [link]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        description: '`Link-p_nom` — nominal power where it is a decision, for a link that is active. A fixed
          build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Process_maintenance:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active
        bounds: {lower: 0.0, upper: 1.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Process-maintenance` — whether a maintainable process is in maintenance: continuous,
          and one exactly where an event covers the snapshot'
      Process_maintenance_capacity:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        bounds: {lower: 0.0}
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Process-maintenance_capacity` — the chosen build while in maintenance, zero otherwise:
          the product the `maintcap` rows linearise'
      Process_maintenance_start:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active
        domain: binary
        missing: 0.0
        description: '`Process-maintenance_start` — whether a maintenance event starts in this snapshot'
      Process_p:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_active
        description: '`Process-p` — PyPSA''s internal power `p`. A positive value drives every port at its
          own rate, withdrawing where the rate is negative and injecting where it is positive'
      Process_p_nom_ext:
        dims: [process]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset
        description: '`Process-p_nom` — nominal internal power where it is a decision, for a process that
          is active. A fixed build is the parameter of the same PyPSA name'
      Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_marginal_cost_curve AND Generator_active
        description: '`Generator-marginal_cost_piecewise` — the running cost of a generator that pays along
          a curve, held above the curve'
    constraints:
      Bus_nodal_balance:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Bus_attached
        expression: Bus_injection == 0
        description: '`Bus-nodal_balance` — what is generated at a bus meets the load there, less half of
          every incident line''s and transformer''s loss. What is generated includes storage dispatch and
          stores. It is net of what the links take away, plus what arrives over them after losses and any
          delay at every port they deliver to. Each process port draws or delivers at its own rate, and each
          passive branch carries its flow. PyPSA dissipates a branch''s loss half at either end. Each generator,
          storage unit, store and load term enters with its component''s `sign` (`constraints.py:1480-1481`,
          `:1592`), and an inactive load not at all. A bus nothing is attached to has no row. PyPSA refuses
          one that carries load. The file states no assumption for it.'
      Generator_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * (Generator_p_nom_ext - Generator_maintenance_pu *
          Generator_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Generator-ext-p-lower` — an extendable generator outputs at least its minimum of the
          chosen build'
      Generator_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset
        expression: Generator_p_nom_ext >= Generator_p_nom_min
        description: '`Generator-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Generator_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND Generator_active_asset AND Generator_p_nom_max
        expression: Generator_p_nom_ext <= Generator_p_nom_max
        description: '`Generator-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario.
          A cap of infinity is no row'
      Generator_ext_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * (Generator_p_nom_ext - Generator_maintenance_pu *
          Generator_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Generator-ext-p-upper` — an extendable generator outputs at most what is available
          of the chosen build'
      Generator_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p >= Generator_p_min_pu * Generator_p_nom * (1 - Generator_maintenance_pu *
          Generator_maintenance)
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-lower` — a fixed generator outputs at least its minimum'
      Generator_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Generator_p_nom_extendable AND not Generator_committable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_p <= Generator_p_max_pu * Generator_p_nom * (1 - Generator_maintenance_pu *
          Generator_maintenance)
        description: '`Generator-fix-p-upper` — a fixed generator outputs at most what is available'
      Generator_maint_event_count:
        dims: [generator, scenario]
        where: Generator_maintainable
        expression: sum(Generator_maintenance_start, over=snapshot) == Generator_maintenance_events
        description: '`Generator-maint-event-count` — a maintainable generator holds its number of maintenance
          events over the horizon'
      Generator_maint_start_horizon:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_active AND Generator_maintenance_start_blocked
        expression: Generator_maintenance_start == 0
        description: '`Generator-maint-start-horizon` — no event starts where it could not run its whole duration'
      Generator_maint_window:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_active
        expression: Generator_maintenance == sum(Generator_maintenance_start, over=start, by=Generator_maintenance_cover[covered])
        description: '`Generator-maint-window` — a generator is in maintenance exactly where an event it started
          covers the snapshot. Two events do not overlap, since the maintenance status is at most one'
      Generator_maintcap_lower_nommax:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maint_ext
        expression: Generator_maintenance_capacity >= Generator_p_nom_ext - Generator_p_nom_max * (1 - Generator_maintenance)
        description: '`Generator-maintcap_lower_nommax` — in maintenance, the whole chosen build is taken
          off'
      Generator_maintcap_lower_nommin:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maint_ext AND Generator_p_nom_min > 0
        expression: Generator_maintenance_capacity >= Generator_p_nom_min * Generator_maintenance
        description: '`Generator-maintcap_lower_nommin` — in maintenance, at least the floor of the build
          is taken off'
      Generator_maintcap_upper:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maint_ext
        expression: Generator_maintenance_capacity <= Generator_p_nom_ext - Generator_p_nom_min * (1 - Generator_maintenance)
        description: '`Generator-maintcap_upper` — the build taken off is at most the chosen build in maintenance,
          and at most the build less its floor out of it'
      Generator_maintcap_upper_nommax:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Generator_maint_ext
        expression: Generator_maintenance_capacity <= Generator_p_nom_max * Generator_maintenance
        description: '`Generator-maintcap_upper_nommax` — out of maintenance, no build is taken off'
      Link_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * (Link_p_nom_ext - Link_maintenance_pu * Link_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Link-ext-p-lower` — an extendable link carries at least its minimum of the chosen build,
          negative for the other way'
      Link_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext >= Link_p_nom_min
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Link_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND Link_active_asset AND Link_p_nom_max
        expression: Link_p_nom_ext <= Link_p_nom_max
        description: '`Link-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A cap
          of infinity is no row'
      Link_ext_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * (Link_p_nom_ext - Link_maintenance_pu * Link_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Link-ext-p-upper` — an extendable link carries at most the chosen build'
      Link_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p >= Link_p_min_pu * Link_p_nom * (1 - Link_maintenance_pu * Link_maintenance)
        description: '`Link-fix-p-lower` — a fixed link carries at least its minimum, negative for the other
          way'
      Link_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Link_p_nom_extendable AND not Link_committable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_p <= Link_p_max_pu * Link_p_nom * (1 - Link_maintenance_pu * Link_maintenance)
        description: '`Link-fix-p-upper` — a fixed link carries at most its nominal power'
      Link_maint_event_count:
        dims: [link, scenario]
        where: Link_maintainable
        expression: sum(Link_maintenance_start, over=snapshot) == Link_maintenance_events
        description: '`Link-maint-event-count` — a maintainable link holds its number of maintenance events
          over the horizon'
      Link_maint_start_horizon:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maintainable AND Link_active AND Link_maintenance_start_blocked
        expression: Link_maintenance_start == 0
        description: '`Link-maint-start-horizon` — no event starts where it could not run its whole duration'
      Link_maint_window:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maintainable AND Link_active
        expression: Link_maintenance == sum(Link_maintenance_start, over=start, by=Link_maintenance_cover[covered])
        description: '`Link-maint-window` — a link is in maintenance exactly where an event it started covers
          the snapshot. Two events do not overlap, since the maintenance status is at most one'
      Link_maintcap_lower_nommax:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maint_ext
        expression: Link_maintenance_capacity >= Link_p_nom_ext - Link_p_nom_max * (1 - Link_maintenance)
        description: '`Link-maintcap_lower_nommax` — in maintenance, the whole chosen build is taken off'
      Link_maintcap_lower_nommin:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maint_ext AND Link_p_nom_min > 0
        expression: Link_maintenance_capacity >= Link_p_nom_min * Link_maintenance
        description: '`Link-maintcap_lower_nommin` — in maintenance, at least the floor of the build is taken
          off'
      Link_maintcap_upper:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maint_ext
        expression: Link_maintenance_capacity <= Link_p_nom_ext - Link_p_nom_min * (1 - Link_maintenance)
        description: '`Link-maintcap_upper` — the build taken off is at most the chosen build in maintenance,
          and at most the build less its floor out of it'
      Link_maintcap_upper_nommax:
        dims: [link, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Link_maint_ext
        expression: Link_maintenance_capacity <= Link_p_nom_max * Link_maintenance
        description: '`Link-maintcap_upper_nommax` — out of maintenance, no build is taken off'
      Process_ext_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p >= Process_p_min_pu * (Process_p_nom_ext - Process_maintenance_pu * Process_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Process-ext-p-lower` — an extendable process runs at least its minimum of the chosen
          build, negative for the other way'
      Process_ext_p_nom_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext >= Process_p_nom_min
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-lower` — the chosen build is at least its floor in every scenario'
      Process_ext_p_nom_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND Process_active_asset AND Process_p_nom_max
        expression: Process_p_nom_ext <= Process_p_nom_max
        description: '`Process-ext-p_nom-upper` — the chosen build is at most its cap in every scenario. A
          cap of infinity is no row'
      Process_ext_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * (Process_p_nom_ext - Process_maintenance_pu * Process_maintenance_capacity)
        description: '`Process-ext-p-upper` — an extendable process runs at most the chosen build'
      Process_fix_p_lower:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p >= Process_p_min_pu * Process_p_nom * (1 - Process_maintenance_pu * Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-fix-p-lower` — a fixed process runs at least its minimum, negative for the
          other way'
      Process_fix_p_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: not Process_p_nom_extendable AND not Process_committable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_p <= Process_p_max_pu * Process_p_nom * (1 - Process_maintenance_pu * Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-fix-p-upper` — a fixed process runs at most its nominal power'
      Process_maint_event_count:
        dims: [process, scenario]
        where: Process_maintainable
        expression: sum(Process_maintenance_start, over=snapshot) == Process_maintenance_events
        description: '`Process-maint-event-count` — a maintainable process holds its number of maintenance
          events over the horizon'
      Process_maint_start_horizon:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active AND Process_maintenance_start_blocked
        expression: Process_maintenance_start == 0
        description: '`Process-maint-start-horizon` — no event starts where it could not run its whole duration'
      Process_maint_window:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maintainable AND Process_active
        expression: Process_maintenance == sum(Process_maintenance_start, over=start, by=Process_maintenance_cover[covered])
        description: '`Process-maint-window` — a process is in maintenance exactly where an event it started
          covers the snapshot. Two events do not overlap, since the maintenance status is at most one'
      Process_maintcap_lower_nommax:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity >= Process_p_nom_ext - Process_p_nom_max * (1 - Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-maintcap_lower_nommax` — in maintenance, the whole chosen build is taken off'
      Process_maintcap_lower_nommin:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext AND Process_p_nom_min > 0
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity >= Process_p_nom_min * Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maintcap_lower_nommin` — in maintenance, at least the floor of the build is
          taken off'
      Process_maintcap_upper:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity <= Process_p_nom_ext - Process_p_nom_min * (1 - Process_maintenance)
        description: '`Process-maintcap_upper` — the build taken off is at most the chosen build in maintenance,
          and at most the build less its floor out of it'
      Process_maintcap_upper_nommax:
        dims: [process, scenario, snapshot]
        where: Process_maint_ext
        expression: Process_maintenance_capacity <= Process_p_nom_max * Process_maintenance
        description: '`Process-maintcap_upper_nommax` — out of maintenance, no build is taken off'
    expressions:
      Bus_injection:
        dims: [bus, scenario, snapshot]
        expression: ((Generator_injection + Link_injection) + Load_injection) + Process_injection
        description: what every component puts into a bus, less what it takes out of it. PyPSA writes each
          term into the balance, and a load on its right-hand side
      Generator_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Generator_p_nom_ext * Generator_capital_cost * Generator_capital_weight)}
      Generator_injection: {expression: 'sum(Generator_sign * Generator_p, over=generator, by=Generator_bus[bus])'}
      Generator_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum((Generator_running_cost * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Generator_p * Generator_p)
          * Generator_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=generator), over=snapshot)'}
      Generator_running_cost:
        dims: [generator, scenario, snapshot]
        description: 'what a generator''s output costs in a snapshot: the value read off its piecewise curve
          where it has one, and its linear `marginal_cost` otherwise. A curve replaces the linear cost, as
          PyPSA drops the unit from that term (`optimize.py:333-348`)'
        cases:
          curve: {when: Generator_marginal_cost_curve, expression: Generator_marginal_cost_piecewise}
        otherwise: Generator_p * Generator_marginal_cost
      Link_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Link_p_nom_ext * Link_capital_cost * Link_capital_weight)}
      Link_injection: {expression: '-sum(Link_p, over=link, by=Link_bus0[bus]) + sum(Link_output_arrival,
          over=link_output, by=Link_output_bus[bus])'}
      Link_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Link_p * Link_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Link_p * Link_p) * Link_marginal_cost_quadratic)
          * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=link),
          over=snapshot)'}
      Link_output_arrival:
        dims: [link_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a link delivers to an output port at a snapshot. It is its flow delayed by the port's
          `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's efficiency at the snapshot
          the flow arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed flow wraps from the period's end.
          Where it is not, the flow still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port that
          does not delay (`delay` zero) delivers its flow unshifted, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Link_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Link_p, by=Link_output_link[link]), along=snapshot, offset=Link_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Link_efficiency
      Load_demand:
        dims: [load, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a load draws from its bus's balance. It is its demand times its sign where it is
          active, and nothing where it is not. PyPSA drops an inactive load from the balance (`constraints.py:1591-1592`)
        cases:
          active: {when: Load_active, expression: Load_sign * Load_p_set}
        otherwise: '0'
      Load_injection: {expression: 'sum(Load_demand, over=load, by=Load_bus[bus])'}
      Process_capex: {expression: sum(scenario_weight * Process_p_nom_ext * Process_capital_cost * Process_capital_weight)}
      Process_injection: {expression: 'sum(Process_output_arrival, over=process_output, by=Process_output_bus[bus])'}
      Process_opex: {expression: 'sum(sum(((Process_p * Process_marginal_cost) * snapshot_weightings_objective)
          * at(period_weight_objective, by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot) + sum(sum((((Process_p
          * Process_p) * Process_marginal_cost_quadratic) * snapshot_weightings_objective) * at(period_weight_objective,
          by=snapshot_period[period]), over=process), over=snapshot)'}
      Process_output_arrival:
        dims: [process_output, scenario, snapshot]
        description: what a process transfers at a port at a snapshot. It is its internal power delayed by
          the port's `delay` within its investment period. It is multiplied by the port's rate at the snapshot
          the transfer arrives. Where the port is `cyclic_delay`, the delayed transfer wraps from the period's
          end. Where it is not, the energy still in transit at the period's first snapshots is lost. A port
          that does not delay (`delay` zero) transfers at once, cyclic or not
        cases:
          wrapping: {when: Process_output_cyclic_delay, expression: 'shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]),
              along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay, edge=''wrap'', within=snapshot_period[period])
              * Process_rate'}
        otherwise: shift(at(Process_p, by=Process_output_process[process]), along=snapshot, offset=Process_output_delay,
          edge=0, within=snapshot_period[period]) * Process_rate
      risk_weighted_opex: {expression: 'sum(scenario_weight * scenario_opex, over=scenario)'}
      scenario_opex:
        dims: [scenario]
        expression: (Generator_opex + Link_opex) + Process_opex
        description: 'what a future costs to run: every operating term, weighted by the snapshot''s hours
          and its period, before the scenario''s own weight. A start and a stop cost what they cost, unweighted,
          as PyPSA adds them (`optimize.py:448-468`)'
      total_cost:
        dims: []
        expression: ((Generator_capex + Link_capex) + Process_capex) + risk_weighted_opex
        description: what the system costs. Capacity counts once per active period at its expected cost over
          the scenarios. Operation counts in expectation over the scenarios, and a share of it at the tail
    conditions:
      Generator_maint_ext: {condition: Generator_maintainable AND Generator_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Generator_committable
          AND Generator_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Generator_active, description: 'a maintainable generator with an
          extendable build that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular.
          These are the maintenance rows against the chosen build'}
      Generator_marginal_cost_curve: {condition: 'count(Generator_marginal_cost_curve_p, over=breakpoint)
          > 0 AND Generator_active_asset', description: 'a generator that pays along a piecewise `marginal_cost`
          curve: one of PyPSA''s `active_assets` with curve data (`optimize.py:307`, `piecewise.py:230-257`)'}
      Link_maint_ext: {condition: Link_maintainable AND Link_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Link_committable AND
          Link_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Link_active, description: 'a maintainable link with an extendable build
          that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular. These are the maintenance
          rows against the chosen build'}
      Process_maint_ext: {condition: Process_maintainable AND Process_p_nom_extendable AND NOT (Process_committable
          AND Process_p_nom_mod > 0) AND Process_active, description: 'a maintainable process with an extendable
          build that is active in the snapshot''s period, unless it is committable and modular. These are
          the maintenance rows against the chosen build'}
    objective: {sense: minimize, expression: total_cost}
    ```

    The prep — every table the spec declares, from the network — and the solve:

    ```python
    from differential.pypsa.prep import relation, static, varying, weighting


    n = build()  # the network from the PyPSA tab

    sources = {
        'bus': pl.Series('bus', list(names(n.buses.index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String),
            **{
                dim: pl.Series(dim, list(names(n.static(component).index).astype(str)), dtype=pl.String)
                for component, dim in DIM.items()
            },
            **scenarios(n),
            **periods(n, multi),
            **carriers(n, multi),
        'snapshot': pl.Series('snapshot', list(timesteps(n)), dtype=pl.Datetime('us')),
        'Generator_bus': relation(n, 'Generator', 'bus'),
        'Link_bus0': relation(n, 'Link', 'bus0'),
        'Load_bus': relation(n, 'Load', 'bus'),
        'Bus_attached': attached(n),
        'Generator_sign': per_component('Generator', first_scenario(n.generators['sign'])),
        'Load_active': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['active']), bool),
        'Load_p_set': varying(n, 'Load', 'p_set'),
        'Load_sign': per_component('Load', first_scenario(loads['sign'])),
        'snapshot_weightings_objective': weighting(n, 'objective'),
    }

    with sps.solve('differential/pypsa/rungs/rung_33_maintenance.yaml', sources) as result:
        result.objective  # 7367.560185
    ```

=== "PyPSA"

    The network, `rung_33_maintenance.py` in the corpus — the spine plus what this rung adds:

    ```python
    # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: mathspec Contributors
    #
    # SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

    """Rung 33: maintenance — a fixed and an extendable generator, link and process, each taken off for events that the generator weightings time."""

    from __future__ import annotations

    import spine


    def build():
        """The spine plus an east bus and six maintainable components, fixed and extendable, with a dear peaker to cover them."""
        n = spine.build()
        n.add('Bus', 'east')
        n.add('Generator', 'hydro', bus='north', p_nom=50, marginal_cost=2, maintainable=True, maintenance_duration=3)
        n.add(
            'Generator',
            'wind_ext',
            bus='south',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_min=10,
            p_nom_max=60,
            capital_cost=20,
            marginal_cost=1,
            p_max_pu=[0.9, 0.6, 0.8, 0.7],
            maintainable=True,
            maintenance_duration=2,
            maintenance_pu=0.5,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'tie_fix',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            p_nom=30,
            efficiency=0.95,
            maintainable=True,
            maintenance_duration=1,
            maintenance_events=2,
        )
        n.add(
            'Link',
            'tie_ext',
            bus0='south',
            bus1='east',
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_min=5,
            p_nom_max=40,
            capital_cost=4,
            efficiency=0.9,
            p_min_pu=-1,
            maintainable=True,
            maintenance_duration=3,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'conv_fix',
            bus0='north',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            p_nom=25,
            maintainable=True,
            maintenance_duration=3,
            maintenance_pu=0.6,
        )
        n.add(
            'Process',
            'conv_ext',
            bus0='south',
            bus1='east',
            rate0=-1.25,
            p_nom_extendable=True,
            p_nom_min=5,
            p_nom_max=30,
            capital_cost=3,
            maintainable=True,
            maintenance_duration=1,
        )
        n.add('Generator', 'east_peak', bus='east', p_nom=100, marginal_cost=60)
        n.add('Load', 'east_load', bus='east', p_set=[50, 60, 40, 55])
        return n
    ```

    ```python
    n = build()
    n.optimize(solver_name='highs')
    n.objective  # 7367.560185
    ```
